payload.body:
For 005ab9256829d4b7f158376486a8223ee9710c67, this was the error without the fix:

```
1x BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua:1786: calling 'SetSize' on bad self (Attempt to access forbidden object from code tainted by an AddOn - Usage: self:SetSize(x, y))
[BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua]:1786: in function <BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua:1785>
[BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua]:1898: in function <BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua:1868>
[BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua]:1660: in function 'UpdateAnchors'
[BigWigs_Plugins/Auras.lua]:1612: in function '?'
[BigWigs_Core/Core.lua]:53: in function <BigWigs_Core/Core.lua:47>
```

This can probably be improved upon if you intend to allow all the other customization during combat, or if not, some user feedback ought to be provided.
